headlines.title: Luigi Mangione tells judge of ‘intent to shoot Brian Thompson’
headlines.description: Luigi Mangione told a federal judge that he “shot Mr. Thompson in Manhattan in the back,” adding that he understood his actions and knew what he was doing.

headlines.title: Trump dismisses concerns from families about grim conditions aboard USS Lincoln
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Friday dismissed concerns from families of service members about the grim conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, whose deployment had been overextended in the Middle East due to the Iran war.

headlines.title: Trump delivers speech on Long Island to law enforcement
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Donald Trump travels to Long Island to visit a police academy in Garden City, New York, with Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman, the Republican nominee for governor, where the president will deliver remarks.

headlines.title: Woman arrested and facing felony charges in World War II Memorial vandalism case, DOJ says
headlines.description: A woman accused of vandalizing the World War II Memorial has been arrested in Washington, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro announced Friday.

headlines.title: ‘Tinderbox’ Britain bans disposable barbecues, sends nationwide fire alerts as Europe battles blazes
headlines.description: LONDON — The U.K. imposed a temporary ban on the sale of disposable barbecues and sent a nationwide alert warning of a “very high risk of wildfires” as European countries battle to keep blazes under control.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Tyler Duckworth, ‘The Challenge’ star and reality TV veteran, dies at 44
headlines.description: Tyler Duckworth, the reality TV veteran who competed on MTV’s “The Challenge” and appeared on “The Real World: Key West,” has died, police said on Friday.

headlines.title: Funeral to be held for Black man fatally shot by Madison police
headlines.description: A 38-year-old Black man who was shot and killed by police in Madison, Wisconsin, will be laid to rest Friday.
